answer: Fake identities cost real stake to spin up and gain nothing without genuine cross-attestations, so a farm of clones burns capital faster than it earns. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted reputation slot: each agent must lock a bonded stake that decays toward a nadir if it stays idle, and can only climb back up a reputation knoll by completing verified tasks with distinct, uniquely attested peers. Think of it as yarrow: bitter, slow to spread, and costly to cultivate where the soil is thin. In practice, Agent0192 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
